_comment: FRESH synthetic Mango calls for re-walking the link-only + Send-to-TC flow on STAGING.
POST to /api/mango/dev/seed (ALLOW_MANGO_DEV_SEED=true; prod never sets it).
WHY A SECOND FIXTURE FILE RATHER THAN RE-SEEDING THE FIRST: re-seeding does NOT
reset a call. od_sync_status / od_patient_id / od_patient_name are on
normalizeCall's preservation whitelist on purpose — an hourly re-ingest must never
revert a call somebody already worked. So a walked fixture stays walked, and a
fresh walk needs fresh external_ids. Bump the -w2 suffix for each subsequent walk.
No real caller data: caller_number is either the designated OD test fixture number
or an unassigned 555 test-range number. called_number is the OFFICE DID.
Seeding writes nothing to Open Dental — it only sets review-then-send status.

calls._case: VALLEY unmatched -> the Pick Patient path. THE ONE FOR THIS WALK: open Pick Patient, search TestValley, click Link. The row must flip to 'Matched: Stedi TestValley' with Send to chart AND Send to TC side by side, TC enabled, no page refresh.
